name: API Contracts and Compatibility
description: Design and evolve REST or tool API contracts with explicit validation, authorization, retry semantics, pagination, errors and compatibility. Use when clients and services need a stable shared boundary.

name: Evidence-Based Architecture Decisions
description: Evaluate and record architecture decisions with constraints, invariants, alternatives, evidence and rollout/reversal criteria. Use for meaningful design choices rather than routine implementation detail.

name: Technical Content Ideation
description: Frame evidence-backed technical content ideas from engineering lessons, architecture decisions, implementation tradeoffs, and useful questions.

name: Technical Content Repurposing
description: Adapt one verified technical idea for LinkedIn, Medium, and GitHub while preserving provenance, factual limits, and platform-specific purpose.

name: Technical Content Review
description: Review technical content for factual grounding, source provenance, privacy, clarity, platform fit, and explicit approval before publication.

name: Technical Content Editing
description: Edit technical writing for evidence, clarity, structure, accessible language, and platform fit while preserving factual limits.

name: GitHub Technical Documentation Writing
description: Write GitHub architecture documentation, READMEs, ADRs, examples, reproducible installation commands, troubleshooting, and API usage guides.

name: Technical Content Hooks
description: Create honest technical openings for LinkedIn posts, Medium articles, documentation, and engineering lessons without hype or engagement bait.

name: LinkedIn Technical Writing
description: Write a LinkedIn post about an engineering lesson, technical insight, architecture decision, career lesson, or concise mini tutorial.

name: Medium Technical Article Writing
description: Create a Medium architecture article or long-form technical explanation with first-principles reasoning, implementation detail, and tradeoffs.

name: Technical Explanation
description: Explain an engineering concept from first principles with definitions, mechanisms, examples, invariants, tradeoffs, and practical application.

name: Technical Storytelling
description: Turn a verified engineering experience into a technical story with setup, tension, explanation, resolution, and a useful lesson.

name: Async Django Engineering
description: Implement and diagnose Django async views, async ORM evaluation, ASGI middleware boundaries, cancellation, and safe synchronous transaction bridges. Use when concurrency or async-safety is part of the task.

name: Django Durable Background Jobs
description: Design Django background work with commit-safe scheduling, durable operation identity, retries, outbox delivery, and worker lifecycle. Use for queued tasks and reliable side effects, not request-local asyncio concurrency.

name: Django ORM and Transaction Design
description: Design Django queries, database constraints, atomic state transitions, efficient relationship loading, and safe schema/data migrations. Use for ORM correctness, N+1 problems, races, or migration reviews.

name: Production Django Engineering
description: Build and review Django applications with explicit domain boundaries, authorized queries, validated input, migration discipline, and production settings. Use for synchronous Django features and service design.

name: Django REST Framework Contracts
description: Build Django REST Framework APIs with explicit serializers, authorized querysets, object permissions, bounded pagination, schema contracts, and error behavior. Use for DRF views and viewsets.

name: Django Behavioral and Async Testing
description: Test Django and async Django behavior with appropriate test classes, AsyncClient, real permission/CSRF boundaries, query budgets, commit hooks, and production-engine integration checks.

name: Production Docker and Compose
description: Build reproducible containers and operate Compose services with explicit secrets, network boundaries, readiness, persistent state and recovery. Use for Dockerfile, build and deployment changes.

name: Risk-Focused Code Review
description: Review a change for concrete correctness, authorization, concurrency, migration and operational regressions using evidence from code and tests. Use for requested reviews and high-risk implementation checks.

name: Reliable Data Pipelines
description: Build and review repeatable ingestion and transformation pipelines with explicit schema, deduplication, checkpoints, late-data policy and recovery. Use for batch imports, ETL and analytics jobs.

name: Systematic Debugging and Incident Diagnosis
description: Diagnose failures through a minimal reproduction, bounded hypotheses, boundary evidence and verified repairs. Use for incorrect behavior, intermittent failures and performance regressions.

name: FastAPI Async Lifespan and Work Budgets
description: Design FastAPI lifespan-owned clients, nonblocking request paths, bounded concurrency, cancellation and durable-work boundaries. Use for resource lifecycle and async performance/correctness changes.

name: FastAPI Authentication and Resource Authorization
description: Implement FastAPI identity verification, dependency-based scope checks and per-resource authorization without trusting client headers or UI filters. Use for authentication, grants, and protected API flows.

name: FastAPI Production Engineering
description: Production service boundaries, lifecycle management, and API validation for FastAPI.

name: FastAPI Boundary and Lifespan Testing
description: Test FastAPI validation, authorization, serialization, lifecycle, retries and failures at the real HTTP boundary using controlled adapters and appropriate integration infrastructure.

name: React State and Accessible Interaction
description: Build React interactions with clear state ownership, accessible forms, focus/error behavior and correct effect cleanup. Use for functional UI work and interaction regressions.

name: TypeScript Runtime and API Contracts
description: Design TypeScript client contracts with runtime validation, discriminated states, null semantics and compatible API changes. Use for typed frontend/data boundaries rather than cosmetic UI edits.

name: MongoDB Data Integrity and Query Design
description: Design MongoDB documents, validation, indexes, atomic updates and transactions around real ownership and query workloads. Use for persistence correctness, schema evolution and query performance.

name: Hybrid Retrieval Evaluation
description: Evaluate and tune lexical/vector/hybrid retrieval using representative queries, authorized candidate sets, deduplication, context budgets and failure-mode evidence. Use for search quality and ranking changes.

name: Verified Backup and Recovery
description: Create and verify backup/recovery procedures that preserve durable state, isolate restore tests and rebuild derived indexes. Use for backup changes and explicitly intended recovery.

name: Service Observability and Capacity
description: Instrument service behavior with bounded safe logs, useful metrics, correlation and capacity evidence. Use for operability, diagnosis and performance work.

name: Agent Context Retrieval and Handoff
description: Use this platform with explicit project resolution, bounded skill/context retrieval, intentional durable writes, revision checks and cross-agent handoff. Use for Codex, Claude, Gemini or custom MCP workflows.

name: Research Evidence and Controlled Learning
description: Build evidence-linked research claims and reviewed knowledge candidates without confusing retrieval relevance with truth or automatically promoting generated content. Use for research and controlled learning workflows.

name: PostgreSQL Schema Evolution
description: Plan PostgreSQL schema/index changes around lock behavior, rolling compatibility, bounded backfills and recovery. Use for migrations and persistence changes that can affect live availability.

name: Python Structured Async Concurrency
description: Design Python async I/O with owned tasks and clients, bounded concurrency, deadlines, cancellation cleanup, and blocking-work boundaries. Use for concurrency correctness and event-loop performance.

name: Strict Python Engineering
description: Typed, testable Python practices for production services.

name: Python Behavioral Testing
description: Choose and implement Python tests that prove behavior, failure handling, boundary contracts, and isolation. Use for regressions, service changes and test reliability; match test depth to change risk.

name: Application Security Boundaries
description: Implement and review application trust boundaries, resource authorization, secret handling and untrusted input controls. Use for authentication/authorization changes, ingestion and concrete security-sensitive flows.
